label: heuristic cue rubric; not calibrated to consumer ratings

ad_copy.regex: \b(?:your|you have|we know (?:your|about your))\s+(?:diagnosis|medical history|pregnancy|fertility|debt|credit score|income|religion|sexual orientation|mental health|prescription|bank balance)\b

\b(?:we(?:'|’)ve been keeping track|we (?:are )?(?:tracking|monitoring|watching|tracked|monitored) (?:you|your)|we (?:keep|kept) track of your (?:activity|visits)|keeping track of your activity|we know (?:where you are|what you did|you (?:are|(?:'|’)re) in [A-Z][a-z]+)|we(?:'|’)ve followed your activity)\b
\b(?:near your (?:home|office|current location)|at your (?:address|home)|you are (?:now |currently )?(?:at|near)|we know you(?:'|’)re currently at)\b

\b(?:available near you|stores? near you|deals? near you|looking for .{0,60}? in [A-Z][a-z]+|(?:your|you(?:'|’)re) (?:in|near) [A-Z][a-z]+|location in [A-Z][a-z]+|(?:we )?(?:also )?know you(?: are|(?:'|’)re)(?: currently)? in [A-Z][a-z]+)\b

\b(?:we (?:noticed|saw) (?:that )?you(?:'|’)?(?:ve)? (?:were |have been )?(?:searched|searching|browsed|browsing|visited|visiting|viewed|viewing|checking)|we noticed your recent interest|your recent (?:searches|browsing|views|interest)|based on your (?:recent )?(?:.{0,35}? )?(?:searches|browsing|viewing)|you (?:recently |have been |were )?(?:searched for|searching for|browsed|browsing|viewed|viewing|visited|visiting)|you checked several .{0,60}?websites|sites? you visited|your visits to .{0,35}?sites?)\b

\b(?:your (?:recent|last|previous|past) (?:.{0,30}? )?(?:purchases?|orders?)|previous .{0,30}? purchases?|based on your (?:past|previous|recent|last) (?:purchase|order)|you (?:bought|purchased)|your (?:shopping )?cart|left .{0,50}? in your cart)\b
\b(?:based on your interests?|because you like|you told us you like)\b

pressure.regex: \b(?:last chance|today only|click (?:the )?link now|act now|hurry|before the timer runs out)\b
\b(?:they do not want you to see|we get taken down|taken down|alert!{2,})\b

combined_signals.condition: at least two of browsing_history, purchase_history, approximate_location, precise_location, sensitive_personal_fact

specific_activity_detail.regex: \b(?:last night|yesterday|compared prices|left without buying|didn(?:'|’)t purchase|did not purchase|several .{0,30}? websites)\b

excessive_exclamation.condition: at least two runs of three or more exclamation marks

deny_scope_guard.condition: skip a cue with a local explicit denial; inspect later matches
